author: GameSpot
description:
Castlevania: Belmont's Curse will be released on October 15th, 2026 (Thursday), and pre-orders are now being accepted! In 1499, as the bells announcing the end of medieval Paris ring out, the French capital is under attack by a horde of monsters that have suddenly appeared. 

Trevor Belmont, the hero who killed Dracula and wields the sacred whip "Vampire Killer," and his daughter Rose Belmont, begin exploring the city and hunting down the monsters to uncover the source of this calamity. Rose soon finds herself entangled in a dark conspiracy lurking behind it all. Can she save Paris?

Tune in to KONAMI PRESS START, for a showcase featuring the latest news and updates on Konami's upcoming projects and current available titles, including SILENT HILL: Townfall, Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse, and Rev. NOiR.

author: GameSpot
description:
The Dead True ghost-hunting crew are chasing their biggest story yet. After an investigation at Blackwood Sanitorium takes a chilling turn, an encounter with supernatural survivor Yoona leads them to Akishima Island, a remote paradise abandoned for decades and hiding secrets far older than any of them imagined.

As the night unfolds, your choices will decide what happens next. Follow a signal in search of a missing friend, or risk a detour that could uncover vital clues. Make the sacrifice you’re told to make, or choose another way. Every decision can change the story, and determine who survives.

Until Dawn 2 launches January 28, 2027 on PS5.
Pre-order the Standard or Digital Deluxe Edition from September 10 to unlock Dr. Hill-themed content. The Digital Deluxe Edition also includes the Y2K Neon Vibes Pack and Dioramas of Death extra feature.

Everyone Can Live. Everyone Can Die.

author: GameSpot
description:
We’re thrilled to finally announce that METRO 2039 is set to launch on all platforms on February 4th 2027!*

In addition, we can confirm that a 60FPS Performance Mode with ray tracing support will be available at launch for the Xbox Series X™, PlayStation® 5 and PlayStation® 5 Pro consoles.

We’ll be sharing much more about the technology, specs and different modes powering all editions of METRO 2039 in the months between now and release.

In the meantime, we’ve just released the very first console gameplay footage of METRO 2039. Featured as part of Sony’s State of Play showcase, all footage in the trailer below was captured on the PlayStation® 5 Pro at 60FPS in Performance Mode.

(* Available February 5th in some territories including Asia, Australia & New Zealand.)

Although METRO 2039 is first and foremost a story-rich FPS, we wanted our first console footage to focus on raw gameplay, environmental detail, kinetic combat, and the technological advances that have been made since 201
title: METRO 2039 | Release Date Reveal & First Console Gameplay Trailer

description:
The Wilds evolve with the massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, coming in 2027!

A giant dragon's sudden siege heralds change in the Forbidden Lands, for both land and sky. Bracing for danger, the Expedition steels themselves as familiar and undiscovered Elder Dragons emerge - and a disturbing new threat prowls the land.
 
*Footage represents a game still in development. The main Monster Hunter Wilds game is required to play Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance. 
 
About Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance
Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in 2027 on PS5.
